Game Overview

At its heart, Ninja Boy Flying is a arcade game about fly through danger under the guise of Ninja Boy, navigating treacherous terrains while collecting coins and vanquishing foes. Master thrilling mechanics like tapping, double-tapping, and long-press to unleash your powers and soar using flying reels. Precision timing and swift reactions turn this arcade adventure into a thrilling airborne escapade.
